usage: workflow init [-h] [--path PATH] [--dry-run] [--force] [--skip-sync]
                     [--adopt-manual]

Initialize the repo-owned v2 scaffold in the target directory without deleting
preserved legacy `.ai/` state.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --path PATH     Target repo path; defaults to the current directory
  --dry-run
  --force
  --skip-sync
  --adopt-manual  Preserve existing manual AGENTS.md and .specify/* files
                  while creating missing workflow metadata, managed role
                  pointer, generated shims, and mirror lock.
